'''Assistant Medic''' was a rank held by medical personnel in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. [[Astina Griek]] held the position at [[Eyrie Base]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="J10">{{JournalCite|10|Desperate Measures}}</ref>
